name: Medicine Ball Halo
cardText:
Medicine Ball Halo
Beginner
1
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, hold a medicine ball.
2
Circle the ball around your head, maintaining control.
3
Complete the desired number of repetitions in both directions.

name: Medicine Ball Partner Situp Toss
cardText:
Medicine Ball Partner Situp Toss
Beginner
1
Lie facing partner, knees bent.
2
Sit up, toss medicine ball to partner.
3
Catch and lower down. Repeat for desired reps.

name: Medicine Ball Plank
cardText:
Medicine Ball Plank
Beginner
1
Place forearms on medicine ball, extend legs.
2
Maintain straight body position for desired time.

name: Medicine Ball Slam
cardText:
Medicine Ball Slam
Beginner
1
Lift medicine ball overhead.
2
Slam ball down to ground with force.

name: Medicine Ball Hollow Hold
cardText:
Medicine Ball Hollow Hold
Intermediate
1
Lie on your back, holding a medicine ball overhead.
2
Lift your shoulders and legs off the ground, engaging core.
3
Hold the position while maintaining stability.

name: Medicine Ball Dead Bug
cardText:
Medicine Ball Dead Bug
Intermediate
1
Lie on your back, place a medicine ball between your extended arms and bent knees.
2
Lower opposite arm and leg to floor, keeping back pressed against ground and medicine ball in place.
3
Alternate sides, maintain core engagement, and repeat for desired reps or time.
